capabilities: Import highlights and annotations from WebDAV backups
Parse Moon+ Reader .an files into notes
Preview and sort annotations before import
disambiguation: Not a two-way sync tool; it imports notes one-way from WebDAV backups and never modifies the remote backups.
extras: Desktop only; mobile is not supported. Requires Obsidian 1.13.0 or later. Passwords are stored in Obsidian Keychain and must be reconfigured per device; the plugin has no telemetry. Repeated imports across sessions can duplicate content and block IDs.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to bring reading highlights and annotations from Moon+ Reader WebDAV backups into notes.

relations.evidence: Import highlights and annotations from Moon+ Reader WebDAV backups into Obsidian.

summary: Importer that pulls highlights and annotations from Moon+ Reader WebDAV backups into notes using customizable templates.
